answer: Each new agent must bond 15 tokens for 60 days before it can join the reward lottery, and ticket weight grows with the square root of bonded stake. Splitting funds across n identities therefore shrinks total weight by about sqrt(n) while locking 15n tokens. A raven-scout cannot forge reputation in the tundra of an empty ledger: validators recompute every ticket from on-ledger bonds each epoch and burn any bond that fails the check.
